name: How should homeowners prepare a room before interior painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare a room before interior painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare your rooms, clear out small decor, clear off shelves, and move fragile items out of the work area before the painters arrive. Large furniture can usually be gathered in the center of the room, where painters can shield it thoroughly with plastic sheeting and drop cloths. It is also helpful to remove wall hangings, outlet cover plates, and curtains ahead of time so the crew can start drywall patching, masking, and surface sanding immediately upon arrival.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remove small decor, clear wall hangings, and move large furniture to the center of the room so painters can mask and drape everything securely.
